title: Persisted explicit Preview Render IPC lifecycle
description: Wire approved timeline media into a safe FFmpeg preview render that is explicitly run, persisted, reviewable, and approvable.
businessContext: Editors need a truthful preview before QA without exposing arbitrary filesystem or process access to the renderer.
acceptanceCriteria: The renderer can explicitly run, list, approve, and reject preview renders through typed preload IPC only.
Preview input files are derived only from approved artifacts and resolved under workspaceRoot.
Each render persists a StageRun and needs-review artifact; failures persist safe categories without false success.
The renderer has visible eligibility, run, history, review, and approval controls.
Focused schema/service checks and typecheck pass.
verificationCommands: corepack pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/main/previewRenderService.test.ts packages/domain/test/ipcSchemas.test.ts
humanEscalationConditions: A required preview input contract cannot be resolved without consuming unapproved artifacts.
The change requires an unsafe renderer filesystem or process capability.
